steps.en: Indicator already applied to all outstanding notices of the offender
steps.id: Indicator sudah dipasang ke semua notice outstanding milik offender

steps.en: A daily check looks for new appeals under the person's ID
steps.id: Pengecekan harian mencari appeal baru atas ID orang tersebut
steps.why_en: No daily check against the appeals system exists; the only daily task reads address results from other agencies.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada pengecekan harian ke sistem appeal; satu-satunya tugas harian membaca hasil alamat dari instansi lain.

steps.en: OCMS receives the new appeal details, including the address given
steps.id: OCMS menerima detail appeal baru, termasuk alamat yang disebut
steps.why_en: Nothing in the code receives an address from the appeals system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang menerima alamat dari sistem appeal.

steps.en: OCMS checks whether the appeal address differs from the registered address
steps.id: OCMS mengecek apakah alamat di appeal berbeda dari alamat terdaftar
steps.why_en: Only comparison of agency addresses exists; no comparison with an address from an appeal.
steps.why_id: Hanya ada pembandingan alamat dari instansi; tidak ada pembandingan dengan alamat dari appeal.

steps.en: A work item is created and sent to the officer's dashboard
steps.id: Work item dibuat dan dikirim ke dashboard petugas
steps.why_en: No work item or dashboard item exists for appeal address differences.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada work item atau item dashboard untuk perbedaan alamat appeal.
